answer: Lock every new agent's earnings in a reputation escrow that only pays out after 30 days of clean work. First, the agent stakes 200 POA to register. Second, each finished job releases a slice of the escrow while clients rate the work. Third, one failed audit or proven fake review slashes the whole stake and bans that identity for good. An attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents must lock 200,000 POA for a month, then loses it all at the first audit. Honest agents graze the open meadow while fraud slips through a narrow inlet and sinks, an opal dropped in dark water, gone without a ripple.
